title: Stylist
description:
Vaga: Stylist

Local: Escritório Lapa – São Paulo/SP | 100% Presencial

Chegou a sua hora de dar forma, caimento e desejo ao produto!

Na Centauro, cada detalhe importa. O styling é um pilar fundamental para garantir que o produto chegue ao cliente com máxima fidelidade, estética e impacto visual. Da passadoria ao ajuste final no set, tudo precisa estar impecável antes do clique.

Buscamos um(a) Stylist com olhar contemporâneo, senso estético apurado e perfil mão na massa, para atuar diretamente no estúdio fotográfico, sendo o braço direito da fotografia e garantindo que cada peça seja apresentada com perfeição — seja no corpo do modelo ou no still.

Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Montagem de Looks: Criar composições para fotos de catálogo e campanhas, respeitando o DNA da marca, as tendências de moda e os objetivos comerciais de cada coleção;
  • Preparação de Produtos: Garantir que todas as peças estejam em perfeito estado para a fotografia, realizando passadoria/vaporização técnica, organização e etiquetagem correta;
  • Acompanhamento em Set: Atuar ativamente durante o shooting, ajustando o caimento das roupas no modelo com uso de alfinetes, grampos e clipes, assegurando simetria, fluidez e estética impecável;
  • Styling de Still e Produto: Zelar pela apresentação do produto em fotos fora do corpo, garantindo volume, forma e alinhamento visual;
  • Curadoria de Acessórios: Selecionar, organizar e controlar o acervo de calçados e acessórios que complementam os looks;
  • Gestão de Amostras: Controlar entrada e saída de peças, garantindo cumprimento do cronograma de fotos, sem faltas, trocas ou avarias;
  • Interface com Pós-Produção: Alinhar o que deve ser resolvido no set versus ajustes digitais, contribuindo para eficiência e qualidade final da imagem.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Formação superior completa (desejável formação em Moda, Design de Moda, Produção de Moda ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em estúdios de e-commerce de moda, fotografia de catálogo ou grandes produções;
  • Forte repertório de moda, com domínio de tendências, composição de cores, silhuetas e proporções;
  • Olhar técnico apurado para identificar e corrigir rapidamente defeitos de caimento;
  • Agilidade, organização e familiaridade com fluxos de alto volume em estúdio;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com habilidade para trabalhar em sintonia com fotógrafos, modelos e times criativos;
  • Atenção extrema aos detalhes e senso crítico antes, durante e após o shooting.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Domínio avançado de técnicas de ajuste (pinning) para diferentes tamanhos e tipos de peças;
  • Conhecimento profundo em preparação têxtil, entendendo fibras, tecidos e técnicas corretas de vaporização;
  • Noções sólidas de colorimetria, para compor looks harmoniosos com fundo, luz e identidade visual;
  • Experiência com Ghost Mannequin, still de produto e enchimentos técnicos;
  • Capacidade de analisar proporção e silhueta, garantindo protagonismo da peça-chave;
  • Vivência em controle de SKUs, planilhas e apoio à logística de coleções;
  • Habilidade em orientar modelos em movimentos e poses que valorizem o caimento dos tecidos.

O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Estúdio profissional com alto volume de produção;
  • Atuação direta e integrada com fotografia, estilo, comercial e e-commerce;
  • Autonomia para contribuir com melhorias visuais e de processo;
  • Contato com grandes marcas e categorias esportivas;
  • Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e orientado à excelência;
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento e desenvolvimento em um ecossistema forte de e-commerce.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

Our promise to you:

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry

What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Estágio em Engenharia (Linhas de Transmissão)
description:
Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global. É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. A empresa apoia ativamente o desenvolvimento dos seus empregados e as oportunidades de crescimento são muito amplas.
  • Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios atrativo que inclui plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e alimentação, previdência privada, seguro de vida, wellhub, programa de incentivo de idioma e pós-graduação, além de opções de compra de ações da ENGIE.
  • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão. Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

A sua missão

Como Estagiário(a) da área de Energia, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

As suas principais responsabilidades

  • Apoio na elaboração e atualização de desenhos técnicos, plantas, perfis e documentos de projeto;
  • Suporte na análise de travessias, interferências e soluções técnicas associadas ao traçado da linha;
  • Auxílio na organização e atualização de bases de dados, listas técnicas e documentação de engenharia;
  • Participação na revisão de projetos executivos e documentos "as built";
  • Interface com engenheiros e projetistas no acompanhamento do avanço dos projetos.

Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com

  • Cursando Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em AutoCAD;
  • Noções de programação em Python ou lógica de programação.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a Tractebel, as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE, com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS.

Candidate-se agora mesmo!

title: Investor Relations Managers -Brazil
description:

LandQuire is an innovative property technology company specializing in land investment opportunities. Members of the LandQuire community can discover or share land investment opportunities online and create mutually beneficial partnerships.

• Brazilian & English speaking. French is a plus.

• Excellent organization and planning skills and ability to adapt to changing conditions internally and externally. Education

• Bachelor's Degree

• 2 years' experience in investor relations positions, capital raising, sales, or family offices

• This is a high-performance, fast-paced, distributed start-up organization. The ability to get up to speed quickly, be productive, and successful in an intense work environment is critical

• HQ in Miami, Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally are required

  • Interesting Package and evolution

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56320

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Profissional com mais de 4 anos de experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance utilizando Java e AWS.

Sólida atuação em arquiteturas orientadas a serviços (SOA) e microserviços, com forte envolvimento em sistemas distribuídos e de alta disponibilidade.

Experiência abrangente em construção e integração de APIs REST, mensageria e comunicação entre sistemas. Domínio do Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security), além de ampla vivência com Hibernate/JPA, bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais. Conhecimento avançado em design patterns, boas práticas de engenharia de software, TDD, Clean Code e arquitetura limpa, contribuindo para código sustentável, seguro e de fácil manutenção. Perfil colaborativo, analítico e orientado à entrega de valor, sempre buscando qualidade e eficiência nas soluções desenvolvi

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Analista Contábil Sênior

title: Network Technician
description:
Job Description: Network Technician

Locations: Guarulhos, Brazil

Contract: Long Term

About Teceze

Teceze is a global IT services and consulting company providing reliable end-user computing, infrastructure support, and managed IT services to enterprise clients. We deliver high-quality on-site and remote support, ensuring seamless IT operations for our customers.

Job Overview

Teceze is hiring a Network Technician – Level 1 to support one of our enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will provide first-level network and infrastructure support, assist with installations, troubleshooting, and monitoring, and ensure stable network operations at the client site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 1 support for network-related issues including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and basic routing/switching problems
  • Assist in installation, configuration, and maintenance of network devices such as switches, routers, access points, and firewalls
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to Level 2/3 teams
  • Monitor network performance and report incidents, outages, and security concerns
  • Support cable management, patching, and rack-and-stack activities in data centers and IDF/MDF rooms
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and incident logs
  • Assist with user connectivity issues including VPN, wireless access, and port activation
  • Follow client and Teceze IT standards, policies, and change management procedures
  • Coordinate with onsite and remote teams to ensure timely resolution of issues

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 0–2 years of experience in network or IT infrastructure support
  • Basic knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and subnetting
  • Familiarity with networking hardware (Cisco, HP, Aruba, or similar)
  • Understanding of wired and wireless network concepts
  • Ability to troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Willingness to work onsite and provide shift or on-call support if required

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNA or equivalent networking certification (or in progress)
  • Experience in enterprise or client-facing environments
  • Basic knowledge of network security concepts

title: Especialista de Engenharia de Software
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Ns impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Você será parte ativa da evolução arquitetural para um ecossistema distribuído, event-driven e altamente confiável baseado em AWS, utilizando os melhores padrões da indústria. Também será responsável pelo tombamento de sistemas legados (Mainframe e on premisse) para AWS.

Como Especialista, você terá liberdade e responsabilidade para propor caminhos técnicos, desenhar soluções end-to-end, mentorar engenheiros, conduzir decisões críticas, antecipar riscos e contribuir diretamente para o roadmap de tecnologia da comunidade.

É uma posição para quem quer construir impacto de verdade, influenciar squads e lideranças, criar padrões técnicos duradouros e disseminar boas práticas em escala. Procuramos alguém com visão estratégica, mãos na massa quando necessário e paixão genuína por fazer engenharia de alto nível.

Local: CEIC - Centro Empresarial Itaú Conceição

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido sem escala - 8x por mês (2x por semana presencial)

Responsabilidades:

SRE & Confiabilidade

  • Definir e acompanhar SLIs/SLOs, error budgets e planos de confiabilidade para sistemas jurídicos.
  • Implementar observabilidade de ponta a ponta (logs, métricas, traces), automação de incidentes e postmortems com ações de melhoria.
  • Orquestrar resiliência: chaos testing, circuit breakers, retry policies, rate limiting, backoff.

Arquitetura & Cloud (AWS)

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas cloud (multi-conta, landing zone, well-architected), com foco em segurança e compliance (LGPD, SOX) que sigam os direcionais corporativos do Itaú.
  • Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions), IaC (Terraform) e containerização (Docker/ECS e/ou EKS).
  • Otimização de custo/performance (FinOps) e governança (IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Config, GuardDuty).

Engenharia & Integração

  • Desenhar e implementar integrações com sistemas jurídicos, gestão contratual, assinatura digital, OCR, ML/NLP (quando aplicável), e APIs internas/externas.
  • Desenvolver e dar manutenção em serviços .NET (C#) e rotinas de automação/análise em Python.
  • Garantir padrões de código, testes, segurança por design, e observabilidade embutida.

Segurança & Compliance

  • Aplicar segurança de aplicação (OWASP, SAST/DAST), criptografia, segregação de acesso, masking e data governance orientada à LGPD.
  • Suportar auditorias e evidências técnicas (controles, trilhas, runbooks, playbooks).

Stakeholders & Negociação

  • Conduzir negociação técnica com áreas de negócio e fornecedores, traduzindo requisitos jurídicos em soluções tecnológicas viáveis.
  • Facilitar integração entre squads, jurídico, segurança e produtos, priorizando valor, risco e compliance.

title: People Solutions Global Survey Strategy Lead
description:
Lockton is the world's largest privately held independent insurance brokerage and advisory firm, known for its entrepreneurial spirit, client-first mindset, and collaborative culture. Without outside shareholders, Lockton focuses entirely on delivering innovative solutions that help clients succeed.

In our People Solutions business, we partner with organizations to design benefits, total rewards, and workforce strategies that attract, retain, and engage top talent. From growing companies to global enterprises, we combine deep expertise with actionable insights to create solutions that truly support people and business goals.

Lockton is a great place to work because we value ownership, innovation, and growth. Associates are empowered to make an impact, share ideas, and develop their careers in a culture that emphasizes inclusion, collaboration, and excellence. At Lockton, you can do meaningful work, grow professionally, and be part of a team that genuinely cares about clients and colleagues alike.

The Role

We are seeking a senior leader to shape and execute the strategy, design, governance, and advanced analytics of survey programs that support client decision-making across People Solutions, including employee benefits, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation. This role focuses on translating complex people strategies and plan design considerations into structured, scalable, and data-driven insights for large and multinational employers.

The position requires deep expertise in employee benefits, total rewards, advanced survey methodology, applied social science judgment in question design, and senior leadership in automated analytics and insight generation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, execution, and governance of global and regional surveys supporting People Solutions priorities, leveraging enterprise survey platforms such as Qualtrics.
  • Establish and maintain methodological and technical standards to ensure data quality, consistency, confidentiality, scalability, and longitudinal comparability across clients and geographies.
  • Design and oversee automated survey workflows in Qualtrics, including complex logic, validation rules, versioning, and multi-country deployment.
  • Apply principles from social science, behavioral economics, and organizational psychology to design survey questions that elicit accurate, reliable, and decision-useful responses from senior HR, Total Rewards, Finance, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop survey frameworks that capture people strategy, benefits philosophy, workforce governance, and risk management practices while minimizing response bias and misinterpretation.
  • Design survey content addressing detailed plan provisions and non-cash compensation, including retirement programs, health and welfare benefits, equity-based compensation, deferred compensation, and other non-cash rewards.
  • Lead the development of scalable, automated analytics pipelines to process survey data, reduce manual intervention, and support repeatable benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Partner with analytics and technology teams to integrate Qualtrics outputs with data visualization, benchmarking, and reporting tools (e.g., dashboards and standardized executive reporting).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, translating automated survey outputs into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Present survey findings to executive audiences with clarity and credibility, supported by standardized and dynamic reporting.
  • Interpret survey data to identify market trends, emerging risks, and opportunities across industries and regions.
  • Partner with actuarial, legal, tax, rewards, and other People Solutions specialists to ensure technical accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Lockton's People Solutions survey and benchmarking capabilities through innovation, digital enablement, and analytics-led insights.
  • Provide executive-level oversight, coaching, and quality assurance for consulting and analytics teams involved in survey design, automation, and analysis.
  • Support business development efforts by shaping survey-led client solutions, proposals, and market-facing offerings.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Sociology, Organizational Behavior, Anthropology, Political Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in people strategy, total rewards, employee benefits, or human capital consulting, preferably within a large professional services or advisory firm.
  • Deep knowledge of People Solutions offerings, including employee benefits, total rewards, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation plan design.
  • Extensive experience designing and deploying surveys using Qualtrics, including advanced logic, governance controls, and global distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze survey results in an automated, scalable manner, supporting benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Proven experience applying social science or behavioral research principles to survey design, including question framing, response bias mitigation, and construct validity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence C-suite and senior client stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent).
  • Graduate or advanced study in organizational psychology, behavioral science, economics, sociology, public policy, human factors, or survey methodology, applied in a consulting or business context.
  • Experience integrating Qualtrics with analytics, BI, or data platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SQL-based environments).
  • Familiarity with governance, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to people programs and compensation.
  • Experience leading or scaling repeatable, productized survey and benchmarking solutions.

title: Business Analytics Sênior - Canais Digitais
description:
Sobre o Time
O time de CANAIS DIGITAIS é responsável pela frente de dados voltada para evolução/melhoria do produto e atingimento das metas de negócios. Visando aprimorar a visão entre as jornadas, nosso desafio é atuar no desenvolvimento de uma visão única (single source of trust) e integrada para auxiliar na tomada de decisões mais assertivas nas frentes de dados, CRO, produtos e negócios.
Estamos em busca de um profissional Business Analytics responsável pela criação da camada semântica no Banco Carrefour, que apoia as tribos na melhor estratégia e tomada de decisão baseada em dados conforme a jornada dos produtos. Essa equipe entrega um dos principais produtos de dados da empresa, simplificando o acesso às informações de maneira performática e escalável.
O time atua no formato Spoke e, como parte do escopo de trabalho, o profissional deve atuar consultivamente na tribo, guiando os times nas melhores práticas de uso de dados e entendendo necessidades de desenvolvimento de implementações.
No seu dia-a-dia
  • Atuar como mediador entre as áreas de negócio, tecnologia, dados, UX e marketing;
  • Garantir que os objetivos de negócio sejam alcançados por meio de decisões baseadas em dados por toda a equipe envolvida - promovendo o desenvolvimento da cultura data-driven;
  • Desenvolvimento de estudos e análises utilizando bases de dados comportamentais e transacionais a fim de detectar padrões de comportamento que possam indicar melhorias no produto e/ou negócio.
  • Suporte aos times de desenvolvimento e QA para implementação e validação de tagueamento.
  • Criação de hipóteses para evolução do produto e/ou negócio.
  • Acompanhamento de Testes A/B.
  • Reportar dados e buscar oportunidades de atuação por meio de projetos multidisciplinares.
  • Atuar fortemente dentro da Ferramenta GA4 + Looker Studio.
  • Desenvolver tagbooks para documentação do tagueamento web + app.
  • Garantir que todos os projetos e desenvolvimentos de estudos e análises tenham valor agregado e forneçam ações/insights que geram impacto no negócio.
Perfil Desejado
  • Perfil ambicioso, propositivo e resiliente, que busca crescimento pessoal e profissional em um ambiente com alta intensidade e autonomia;
  • Perfil analítico, ativo, inconformista e independente.
  • Experiência e facilidade em apresentar resultados e traduzir raciocínio para as equipes de negócios e lideranças sêniores;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades de persuasão: escrever bem, ter boa didática ao traduzir o técnico para a visão de negócio.
Competências Técnicas
  • Experiência sólida em consultas de dados via SQL para análise de dados e extração de percepções relevantes.
  • Capacidade para criar backlog de hipóteses para testes A/B, baseado em análises de dados e possíveis oportunidades de melhoria de produtos, demonstrando uma abordagem orientada por dados para impulsionar o desenvolvimento de produtos.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de Business Intelligence como: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc., com capacidade de criar visualizações claras e impactantes.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de análise digital web e aplicativos mobile, incluindo GA4, Firebase, Appsflyer, Adjust, entre outras, para coleta e interpretação de dados de forma abrangente.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado financeiro;
  • Experiência com BigQuery (visualização e manipulação de dados)
Nosso Cliente Oferece
  • Contratação PJ
  • R$500,00 de ajuda de custo mensal
  • Vaga 100% ̈remota
Este Processo Será Conduzido Considerando As Seguintes Etapas
  • Avaliação da inscrição;
  • Papo com a QiBit;
  • Papo com o Cliente;
  • Contratação.
  • As etapas citadas acima poderão sofrer alterações de acordo com o andamento do processo seletivo. Mas não se preocupe, estaremos sempre te atualizando :)

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases.

This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only—someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments.

You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities

Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures to support high-performance application workloads
  • Own database performance tuning, query optimization, and capacity planning across environments
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability strategies in Azure SQL
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention
  • Own database cost management in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence throughout the application lifecycle

Software Development & Feature Delivery

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems
  • Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack
  • Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers

Azure Cloud & DevOps

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure, with a focus on reliability and observability
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost

Required Qualifications

Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)

Technical Skills (Priority Order)

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise, including:

Advanced T-SQL

Stored procedures and query optimization

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis

Performance tuning and troubleshooting

  • Proven experience owning database operations, including:

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery

Performance monitoring and scaling

Cost and capacity management in Azure

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Bonus Points

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar)
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio
  • Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.

Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.

All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.

You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.

Job responsibilities:

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.

Key skills:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

  • Realizar montagem completa de painéis elétricos e painéis de controle conforme diagramas, listas de materiais e especificações de engenharia.
  • Efetuar passagem, identificação, organização e terminação de cabos de potência, controle e comunicação.
  • Instalar infraestrutura elétrica: cable trays, eletrocalhas, leitos, dutos, conduítes e acessórios.
  • Interpretar diagramas unifilares, trifilares, esquemas de ligação, desenhos mecânicos e layouts de montagem.
  • Executar conectorização de componentes elétricos (sensores, inversores, controladores, relés, motores, etc.).
  • Realizar testes básicos e inspeções elétricas conforme procedimentos internos.
  • Atualizar o projeto com marcações ("redlines") quando houver ajustes durante a montagem.
  • Acompanhar padrões de qualidade e boas práticas de montagem conforme normas NR-10, NR-12 e NBRs aplicáveis.
  • Cumprir prazos de montagem, mantendo organização, segurança e desempenho constante.
  • Realizar instalações elétricas em campo conforme necessidade.

  • Ensino Médio completo.

EXPERIÊNCIA:

  • Experiência prática em montagem de painéis elétricos industriais, painéis de controle e infraestrutura elétrica.
  • Vivência com conexão de componentes, identificação de cabos e leitura de diagramas elétricos.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we've defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate's education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Just text "STOP" to any of our texts to unsubscribe. Message & data rates may apply. Message frequency may vary. title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit. This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months, based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurate posting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company's credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuous improvement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposure to business financial decision-making.

This role is critical to advanced technical support, administration and ongoing optimization of all infrastructure. We are looking for an experienced professional who can lead improvement initiatives and provide innovative solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare projects and technical specifications, install, configure, provide support and manage various operating systems, access solutions, antivirus and specific applications.
  • Manage storage, backup and server virtualization solutions.
  • Work in administration and deployments of Microsoft, Linux, Vmware and Hyper-V Servers.
  • Monitor the implementation of new services in the environment, aiming to assimilate new technologies.
  • Maintain all environments managed, keeping them updated and configured in accordance with customer guidelines and best market practices.
  • Monitor and test environmental continuity procedures, recording them.
  • Develop and distribute software/configuration packages on a large scale.
  • Install and maintain server hardware.
  • Interact with manufacturers and service providers if necessary.
  • Provide support to the service desk in incidents and problems in order to resolve issues that exceed the solution conditions in that area.
  • Analyze the problems presented, opening problems in the company's support system, aiming for their resolution.
  • Analyze and research causes, solutions, technologies and costs involved in solving the problems encountered.
  • Recommend environmental improvement solutions.
  • Perform hands-on fixes, including installing and upgrading software, installing hardware,
  • Owns and drives issues to resolution including escalation to specialized resources within the broader IT organization. Remains engaged on issues until resolution.
  • Provide Tier 2 technical support for client facilities such as video conferencing and audio conferencing services.
  • Lead, coordinate and participate in improvements as they relate to the on-site IT environment.
  • Serves as an advocate for the organization's information security management system. Assists customers to work efficiently within the ISMS framework.
  • Test fixes to ensure problems have been adequately resolved.
  • Perform post-resolution follow-ups to customer requests.
  • Evaluate documented resolutions and analyze trends for ways to prevent future problems.
  • Field incoming requests from customers via both telephone and e-mail in a courteous manner.
  • Build reports with customers.
  • Perform preventative maintenance, including checking and cleaning of workstations, printers, and peripherals.
  • Prioritize and escalate problems (when required).
  • Record, track, and document problem-solving processes, including all successful and unsuccessful decisions made, and actions taken, through to final resolution.
  • Apply diagnostic utilities to aid in troubleshooting.
  • Access software updates, drivers, knowledge bases, and frequently asked questions resources on the Internet to aid in problem resolution.
  • Understands the essential responsibilities of the position and works to continuously to build and improve the skills necessary to be proficient in the role.
  • Supports operates and maintains AV equipment for live meetings and events.
  • Provides support and demonstrates expert knowledge for online webinar tools and applications.

Job Holder Requirements

  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a focus on listening and asking probing questions as
  • appropriate.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Ability to conduct research into a wide range of computing issues as required.
  • Ability to absorb and retain information quickly.
  • Ability to present ideas in user-friendly language to non-technical staff and end users.
  • Keen attention to detail.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Exceptional customer service orientation.
  • Ability to represent and advocate for both the policies and procedures of the IT organization the end users' perspective.
  • To resolve assigned tickets in adherence to agreed SLA and quality standards of the company
  • To maintain high login Efficiency (Availability) for customers
  • To resolve tickets within agreed SLA of ticket volume and time
  • To adhere to quality standards (voice and accent, Tech Monitoring), regulatory requirements and company policies
  • To ensure positive customer experience and CSAT through First Call Resolution and minimum average handling time (AHT), rejected resolutions / Reopen Cases
  • To update worklogs and follow shift/ escalation process and process compliance
  • Work on value adding activities such Knowledge base update & self-development.

Technical & Personal Skills:

  • Consistently demonstrates a positive attitude and approach.
  • Demonstrates enthusiasm and dedication.
  • Consistently displays initiative by proactively providing solutions and driving long term objectives toward completion.
  • Demonstrates empathy and focuses on the needs of internal and external clients/contacts where relevant.
  • Focuses on what can be done. When a problem exists, suggest a solution.
  • Builds relationships with stakeholders.
  • Maintains a courteous and professional manner in all dealings.
  • Complete higher education.
  • Postgraduate degree in IT is desirable.
  • Microsoft or Vmware certification preferred
  • Microsoft Windows server Support
  • MS Office Tools, O365, SharePoint, Teams
  • Hardware Support
  • Network Support and Troubleshooting
  • Videoconferencing Support
  • Peripheral Support
  • Monitoring Tools Knowledge
  • Tickets Tools Knowledge (Service Now)

Language Requirements:

  • English, Fluent (Required)

title: Inspetor(a) de qualidade II

title: Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores
description:
Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores | EQI Investimentos

Você sonha em construir uma carreira sólida no mercado financeiro, transformar a vida das pessoas por meio dos investimentos e ter a chance de ser contratado pela empresa que mais cresce no mercado financeiro?

Como participar?

Se você está comprometido com sua evolução profissional e quer começar a trilhar um caminho de sucesso no mercado financeiro, inscreva-se agora!

title: Analista de Ppcm Sr
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar e controlar o plano de manutenção das linhas de produção, bem como realizar a programação de manutenções elétricas e eletrônicas na Unidade Industrial;
  • Planejar as atividades da manutenção nas paradas programadas de fábrica e/ou reatores, administrando a logística de materiais, ferramentas e serviços;
  • Indicar plano de ação e disponibilizar ferramentas e mão de obra, em casos de emergências, paradas de reator e/ou processo ou que impliquem em problemas nos aspectos de qualidade, segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Desenvolver fornecedores com potencial tecnológico para aprimoramento do desempenho dos equipamentos e máquinas a fim de contribuir na implantação de novas práticas de manutenção, nas linhas de produção;
  • Adequar os planos preventivos de equipamentos existentes, analisando as falhas repetitivas e elaborando planos de ação para melhorias, bem como contribuir com a de gestão de projetos de renovação dos mesmos;
  • Analisar criticamente os resultados das rotas de inspeção e manutenção preditiva, informando de maneira clara os riscos em termos de segurança associados à manutenção;
  • Controlar Back log e custos da linha de modo a manter o orçamento definido;
  • Acionar áreas responsáveis e envolvidas em casos de não conformidade ou qualquer problema que possa comprometer a continuidade eficaz e segura do processo produtivo, bem como, afetar a saúde e segurança das pessoas ou qualidade do produto final.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, tecnólogos em mecânica, mecatrônica, automação ou áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Conhecimento de Planejamento de Manutenção;
  • Conhecimento de SAP;
  • Domínio prático e técnico das atividades de manutenção;
  • Noções de mecânica, elétrica e instrumentação.

title: Executivo de Território

A Legrand hoje:

title: Analista Contábil Pleno
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.

title: Assistente de vendas
description:
Tarefas Auxiliar de Vendas

As tarefas de um auxiliar de vendas geralmente envolvem apoiar a equipe comercial e garantir que o processo de vendas seja mais ágil e organizado. Aqui estão as principais responsabilidades:

  • Atualizar planilhas e sistemas de CRM (cadastro de clientes, propostas, follow-ups).
  • Organizar documentos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho (metas, resultados, pipeline).
  • Acompanhar envios considerando fretes e coleta por parte da transportadora.

Apoio Comercial

  • Auxiliar na elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Realizar cotações com fornecedores e validação de estoques.
  • Dar suporte ao time de vendas em apresentações ou reuniões.
  • Acompanhar status de negociações e prazos de entrega.

Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Atender clientes por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre produtos, preços e prazos.
  • Encaminhar contatos para os vendedores responsáveis.
  • Fazer follow-up (acompanhamento) de propostas enviadas.

Organização e Logística

  • Controlar estoque de materiais de apoio (catálogos, brindes, amostras).
  • Acompanhar logística de entregas em conjunto com o setor responsável.
  • Garantir que os vendedores tenham materiais atualizados (catálogos, tabelas de preço).
  • Apoiar na organização do material que foi vendido.

Em resumo, o auxiliar de vendas não atua diretamente na negociação final, mas garante que os vendedores tenham informações, suporte e organização para focar nas vendas.

title: Gerente
description:

title: Técnico(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

"Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM).

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação."

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB).
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura front-end baseada em React (incluindo frameworks como Next.js), garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade.

2. Integração e Uso de Inteligência Artificial

- Liderar a implementação de features baseadas em IA (ex: chatbots, recomendações, automações, análise preditiva, NLP).

- Integrar aplicações React com modelos de IA/LLMs, APIs de machine learning e serviços cloud (ex: inference, embeddings, pipelines).

- Avaliar viabilidade técnica, custos, riscos e impacto de soluções de IA no produto.

3. Desenvolvimento Front-end Avançado

- Desenvolver componentes React complexos, reutilizáveis e de alta performance.

- Garantir boas práticas de estado global, hooks avançados, renderização otimizada e acessibilidade.

- Atuar em code reviews rigorosos, assegurando qualidade, legibilidade e aderência a padrões.

4. Performance, Qualidade e Segurança

- Garantir alta performance, observabilidade e monitoramento das aplicações.

- Definir e acompanhar métricas técnicas (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, erros, latência).

- Assegurar boas práticas de segurança, especialmente em fluxos envolvendo IA e dados sensíveis.

5. Mentoria e Colaboração

- Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) front-end e full stack, promovendo crescimento técnico e autonomia.

- Atuar em parceria com Produto, Design, Data e Backend, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas.

- Facilitar alinhamentos técnicos, refinamentos e decisões em contextos ambíguos.

6. Governança Técnica & Boas Práticas

- Definir padrões de código, guidelines, documentação e estratégias de versionamento.

- Liderar iniciativas de modernização de stack, refatoração e redução de débito técnico.

- Promover cultura de testes (unitários, integração e e2e).

7. Inovação e Visão de Futuro

- Acompanhar tendências em React, Front-end moderno e IA aplicada a produtos.

- Propor melhorias contínuas, POCs e experimentações com novas tecnologias.

- Avaliar impacto técnico e estratégico de novas ferramentas e frameworks.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We're hiring: Business Development Manager (BDM - Mid Level)

At Excent Capital Ltd., we're building a high-performance, globally minded team.

We are a multi-regulated investment broker with international presence and offices in London, Seychelles, St. Vincent, Brazil, and our LATAM headquarters in Mexico City. Our mission is simple: to provide clients and investors with a secure, technology-driven platform to operate in global financial markets while creating real career opportunities for ambitious professionals.

The role is focused on business expansion, managing higher-impact opportunities, and driving results through strategic relationships and advanced execution.

The Role

  • As a Business Development Manager, you will be part of our commercial engine, working closely with our business partners and executing commercial strategies across LATAM, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
  • If you have experience in sales, account management, or business development, and the ability to manage strategic relationships, close higher-value opportunities, and actively contribute to business expansion, this role is designed for you.

You will:

  • Prospect and generate leads across multiple regions and markets.
  • Develop and manage a portfolio of business partners.
  • Execute multichannel outbound outreach and conduct discovery calls.
  • Activate and onboard business partners.
  • Manage and update CRM information with discipline and accuracy.
  • Collaborate closely with business partners to drive business development.

What We're Looking For:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales or a commercial role, including prospecting, B2B sales, and client relationship management (full-time).
  • Graduates in business, finance, marketing, engineering, economics, or related fields.
  • Conversational english (Will be evaluated).
  • Experience in sales and business development.
  • Ambition, high energy, discipline, and a strong willingness to learn.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive net monthly salary.
  • Monthly commissions.
  • Clear career path for your professional growth.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonus
  • Working hours: Monday to Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
  • Short Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.

Competitive package of superior benefits, including:

  • Health insurance
  • 22 days of time off per year
  • International business trips
  • Totalpass
  • Apple equipment
  • Parking at the building

On-site role Close by Berrini, São Paulo - SP.

If you already have experience in sales, are looking to take the next step in your career within an international company, and are eager to continue growing at a fast pace, we'd love to meet you.

title: Associate Sales Manager
description:
Associate Sales Manager – Sao Paolo

Multinational company leader in their sector, is looking for a Sales Manager team lead, in charge of leading 3-5 team members and carrying their own quota. This is a hybrid role where you would have to go to the office 3 days a week.

Job purpose:

To lead a group of 3 – 4 Sales Associates in their day-to-day sales activity. To drive revenue growth through managing your team with their opportunity portfolio, personal marketing activity & personal development. Your role will be compounded by owning your own opportunity portfolio as well; supporting clients in assessing their Human Capital Management strategy & demonstrating why ADP should be their chosen partner.

Key objectives:

  • Responsible for the development & maintenance of a comprehensive plan for team sales activity including pipeline and productivity. Responsible for managing both personal and team quota.
  • Responsible for supporting the wider Leadership group of all active sales processes within the team, ensuring co-ordination of company resource in an optimal and effective manner.
  • To fulfil the standard accountabilities of a Sales Associate in addition to the above objectives.

Key duties/tasks:

  • To monitor the performance of the team daily, coordinating resources, monitoring activity, and where necessary initiating corrective action with Regional Sales Manager to ensure sustainable delivery of results.
  • To generate new business through inbound leads but also personal marketing efforts.
  • To execute on personal quota plus part of team target
  • To manage sales opportunities through direct reports
  • Weekly team & leadership sales forecasting.
  • To work alongside your fellow Leaders in identifying training & development needs across the wider team.
  • Delivering training sessions (ad-hoc)
  • To submit the relevant management reports in a timely manner including up to date forecasting information.
  • Be result driven to ensure a laser focus on overachievement on quota.
  • Responsible for the direction of the team with regards to training, engagement & development.
  • Member of the sales leadership team.

Skills and knowledge:

  • Ability to anticipate, identify and analyze problems and opportunities, establish priorities and effectively apply resolutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of commercial/sales issues preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment.
  • Ability to review and measure progress against specific criteria and take necessary corrective action where appropriate.
  • Must be able to demonstrate excellent communication skills, personal integrity and a positive attitude in all dealings with colleagues/clients.

Education and experience:

  • Must be able to demonstrate extensive direct selling experience, preferably within a Payroll/HR software and service environment and consistent over performance
  • Team Leader/Sales Management experience (desirable).

Base: R$10.552 reais monthly

Target Incentive: 45%

OTE: R$15.300 reais monthly

Health Insurance with dental
